submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at 35 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.417% at the allocated 8 kHz rate. This significantly outperforms Algorithm-L3 (84.3% at 35 GeV) and Algorithm-L1 (73.1% at 35 GeV). The simulation tested multiple threshold values between 20-60 GeV, and 35 GeV was found to be optimal for Algorithm-L2. All candidate algorithms fit within the FPGA resource budget, so hardware deployability is satisfied. This recommendation maximizes signal efficiency while meeting all constraints.
